Description: "Override item price based on selected price tier when adding new items to cart"
Instruction: "Replace the line that adds item to cart to use price tier"
TargetContent: "          const existing = prev.find(c => c.id === item.id);\n          if (existing) return prev.map(c => c.id === item.id ? { ...c, quantity: c.quantity + 1 } : c);\n          return [...prev, { ...item, quantity: 1 }];"
